releaseClaim.userOperation: The operator signs in to the hosted dashboard and finds Sellbird running its outreach loop in the cluster, with training and settings that survive restarts and every email waiting for approval. A local user keeps running Sellbird on SQLite with the token link, unchanged.
supportedEnvironments: hosted: the GKE cluster `main` in us-south1, one replica, Postgres 18 on the shared platform
local: macOS, Linux and Windows with SQLite (CI matrix)
releaseClaim.currentCapabilities: The hosted pod serves the dashboard only; its home folder is temporary; the heartbeat does not run; deploys are not gated on tests; dependencies are not hash-locked. tests and images both pass on main at a661932.

Whether the Claude login in the cluster secret works

Whether the platform will take the overlay change and the SEC-02 and SEC-03 requests in this phase's window

resilienceScope.policy: Adopted requirements never defer via budget overflow; exhaustion means checkpoint and BLOCKED. Only never-adopted optional items may defer.

choosing or configuring the mail provider, verifier and product (operator)

requiredSafetyChecks.description: Approval mode stays on and sending stays paused through the boundary; the sent count does not move
Evidence holds counts, digests, exit codes and timestamps only; a redaction search finds no secret, token, name or address
Control runs of the image workflow can never publish or deploy
Local single-user mode keeps its behaviour

budgets.exhaustion: checkpoint and BLOCKED; never a silent PASS; documentation and state may be saved without running product tests

evidenceInvalidation: Per-scenario invalidation keys (source globs, fixture digests, image digest, contract digest); a change invalidates only the scenarios whose keys it touches; prior evidence and history are preserved; no blanket re-review.
